data.title: KOMMENTAR - Die Finma braucht mehr Biss, aber nicht mehr Bürokratie
data.description: Die Eidgenössische Finanzmarktaufsicht (Finma) soll zur Verhinderung künftiger Bankenkrisen neue Befugnisse erhalten. Im Grundsatz ist das richtig, doch der Gesetzgeber muss die geplanten Instrumente vernünftig kalibrieren.
data.translatedTitle: COMMENT - Finma needs more grit, but not more bureaucracy
data.translatedDescription: The Federal Financial Market Supervisory Authority (Finma) is to be given new powers to prevent future banking crises. In principle this is correct, but the legislature must calibrate the planned instruments sensibly.

data.title: Zum ersten Mal wurde ein Land mithilfe von KI-Agenten angegriffen: Taiwan erlebt, wie Cyberkriegsführung künftig aussehen wird
data.description: KI-Agenten könnten die Cyberattacke grösstenteils autonom durchgeführt haben. Fachleute erwarten, dass sich solche Vorfälle mit den zunehmenden Hacking-Fähigkeiten von KI in Zukunft häufen.
data.translatedTitle: For the first time a country has been attacked with the help of AI agents: Taiwan is experiencing what cyber warfare will look like in the future
data.translatedDescription: AI agents could have carried out the cyberattack largely autonomously. Experts expect such incidents to become more common in the future as AI's hacking capabilities increase.

data.title: Die Columbia University war das Epizentrum der Proteste gegen Israel. Jetzt verklagen Palästinenser die Hochschule wegen Diskriminierung
data.description: Eine Gruppe von Studierenden und Professoren fühlt sich von der Columbia University diskriminiert: Die Hochschulleitung habe sie nach dem Beginn des Gaza-Kriegs nicht genügend vor Angriffen geschützt.
data.translatedTitle: Columbia University was the epicenter of the anti-Israel protests. Now Palestinians are suing the university for discrimination

data.translatedDescription: The Bulls were 2-0 down at half-time in Pafos and faced elimination. A 3:3 at the end ensures Salzburg stays in a European competition. The opponent in the EL play-off is Sweden's champions Mjällby.

data.title: Luka Mladenovic holt bei Schwimm-EM Bronze über 200 m Brust
data.description: Erste Medaille für Österreich bei der Langbahn-EM in Paris. Für Mladenovic soll es mit dem US-Trainer der Schwimmlegenden Phelps und Marchand noch weiter aufwärtsgehen in der Karriere.
data.translatedTitle: Luka Mladenovic wins bronze in the 200 m breaststroke at the European Swimming Championships
data.translatedDescription: First medal for Austria at the European Long Course Championships in Paris. Mladenovic's career will continue to improve with the US coach of swimming legends Phelps and Marchand.

data.title: Klein, aber mächtig: Einzeller enthüllen Veränderung der Meere   [premium]
data.description: Saure Meere zerfressen die Kalkschale von Einzellern, mineralische Sonnencremen schädigen Foraminiferen. Die Uni Wien erforscht, wie sich die Umwelt und die Mikroben in den Ozeanen wandeln. Das Klimaarchiv in ihren Schalen reicht Jahrtausende zurück.
data.translatedTitle: Small but mighty: Single-celled organisms reveal changes in the oceans [premium]
data.translatedDescription: Acidic seas eat away at the limestone shells of single-celled organisms, and mineral sunscreens damage foraminifera. The University of Vienna is researching how the environment and microbes in the oceans are changing. The climate archive in their shells goes back thousands of years.

data.title: Vollelektrisch auf der Langstrecke: Mit dem Äquivalent von sechs Litern Diesel 500 Kilometer weit [premium]
data.description: Wir führten zwei der derzeit besten Elektroautos auf die Langstrecke: Den BMW iX3 und den Mercedes CLA 250+. Mit einem Auto verbrauchten wir lediglich 12,2 kWh/100 Kilometer.
data.translatedTitle: Fully electric on long journeys: travel 500 kilometers with the equivalent of six liters of diesel [premium]
data.translatedDescription: We took two of the best electric cars currently on long journeys: the BMW iX3 and the Mercedes CLA 250+. With a car we only consumed 12.2 kWh/100 kilometers.

data.title: Meta sperrte seit Altersschranke in Australien mehr als 750.000 Konten
data.description: In Australien dürfen nur noch Jugendliche ab 16 Jahren Social-Media-Plattformen nutzen. Doch die Überprüfung gestaltet sich seit der Einführung Anfang des Jahres als schwierig.
data.translatedTitle: Meta suspended more than 750,000 accounts in Australia since the age barrier
data.translatedDescription: In Australia, only young people aged 16 and over are allowed to use social media platforms. But verification has proven difficult since its introduction at the beginning of the year.

data.title: Prokurator Piotr Kosmaty do przełożonych: Mam prawo zabierać głos w interesie publicznym
data.description: W tekście dla „Rzeczpospolitej” zaprezentowałem stanowisko prawne zbieżne z oceną sądu. Pismo, jakie skierowali do mnie przełożeni po tej publikacji, zmierza do wywołania tzw. efektu mrożącego w zakresie przysługującego mi prawa do swobody wypowiedzi.
data.translatedTitle: Prosecutor Piotr Kosmaty to his superiors: I have the right to speak out in the public interest
data.translatedDescription: In the text for "Rzeczpospolita" I presented a legal position consistent with the court's assessment. The letter sent to me by my superiors after this publication aims to trigger the so-called a chilling effect on my right to freedom of expression.

data.title: Iga Świątek zwycięża w Toronto. Wygrał serwis i tenisowa cierpliwość
data.description: Wygrana 6:2, 6:3 w Toronto to sukces, na który jeszcze tydzień temu mało kto liczył. Iga Świątek odradza się jak Feniks z popiołów. I wraca do swojego najlepszego tenisa.
data.translatedTitle: Iga Świątek wins in Toronto. The serve and tennis patience won
data.translatedDescription: The 6-2, 6-3 win in Toronto is a success that few people expected a week ago. Iga Świątek is reborn like a Phoenix from the ashes. And he returns to his best tennis.

data.title: „Odyseja” Nolana daje fałszywe informacje. Bez lektury Homera można w nie uwierzyć
data.description: Naprawdę wierzymy, że „Odyseja” Nolana to metafora wymierzona w bezwzględność Donalda Trumpa? Co jednak byłoby w takim razie odpowiednikiem Troi? Iran? Bez żartów.
data.translatedTitle: Nolan's "Odyssey" gives false information. You can't believe them without reading Homer
data.translatedDescription: Do we really believe that Nolan's "The Odyssey" is a metaphor against Donald Trump's ruthlessness? But what then would be the equivalent of Troy? Iran? No joke.

data.title: Kenia wprowadza obowiązkowe ubezpieczenie dla turystów
data.description: Kenia przygotowuje się do wprowadzenia obowiązkowego ubezpieczenia zdrowotnego dla zagranicznych turystów. Władze określiły już minimalny zakres ochrony i wskazały, w jaki sposób ubezpieczenie będzie sprawdzane.
data.translatedTitle: Kenya introduces compulsory insurance for tourists
data.translatedDescription: Kenya is preparing to introduce compulsory health insurance for foreign tourists. The authorities have already defined the minimum scope of protection and indicated how insurance will be checked.

data.title: Teresa Siudem: Ryzykowne zarządzanie firmą z tylnego fotela
data.description: W firmach rodzinnych zdarza się, że założyciel formalnie rezygnuje z funkcji w zarządzie, jednak nadal podejmuje kluczowe decyzje finansowe. Brak jego nazwiska w rejestrze przedsiębiorców nie wyłącza ryzyka odpowiedzialności za działania firmy.
data.translatedTitle: Teresa Siudem: Risky managing a company from the backseat
data.translatedDescription: In family businesses, it sometimes happens that the founder formally resigns from the management board, but still makes key financial decisions. The lack of his name in the register of entrepreneurs does not exclude the risk of liability for the company's actions.

data.title: Oaza spokoju pod Warszawą nawiązuje do igloo. Dom podróżników odstaje od reszty
data.description: Dom w Konstancinie pod Warszawą miał być przeciwwagą dla życia w ciągłym ruchu. Para podróżników stworzyła tu spokojną przestrzeń do odpoczynku, której projekt przygotowali BBGK Architekci i architektka Katarzyna Mach.
data.translatedTitle: An oasis of peace near Warsaw refers to an igloo. The travelers' house stands out from the rest
data.translatedDescription: The house in Konstancin near Warsaw was supposed to be a counterweight to a life in constant motion. A couple of travelers created a quiet space for rest here, the design of which was prepared by BBGK Architekci and architect Katarzyna Mach.

data.title: Producenci kosmetyków obiecują brak groźnej chemii w składzie. Badanie pokazało prawdę
data.description: Nawet dokładne czytanie składu kosmetyków i środków czystości może nie ochronić konsumentów przed szkodliwą chemią – wynika z najnowszego badania. Aż 85 proc. przeanalizowanych w nim produktów zawierało nieoznakowane związki, które z dużym prawdopodobieństwem powiązane są m.in. z zaburzeniami hormonalnymi czy nowotworami.
data.translatedTitle: Cosmetics manufacturers promise no harmful chemicals in the composition. The study showed the truth
data.translatedDescription: Even carefully reading the ingredients of cosmetics and cleaning products may not protect consumers against harmful chemicals, according to the latest study. As much as 85 percent the products analyzed in it contained unlabeled compounds that are most likely related to, among others, with hormonal disorders or cancer.

data.title: Członek rodziny jako faktyczny decydent – ryzyko odpowiedzialności
data.description: W firmach rodzinnych rzeczywisty wpływ na finanse może mieć większe znaczenie niż stanowisko. Za błędy podatkowe może odpowiadać także osoba, która zarządzała nimi nieformalnie.
data.translatedTitle: A family member as the actual decision-maker – risk of liability
data.translatedDescription: In family businesses, the actual impact on finances may be more important than the position. The person who managed them informally may also be responsible for tax errors.

data.title: Jak skutecznie przygotować się do sprzedaży biznesu?
data.description: Sprzedaż firmy to proces, który warto zaplanować z dużym wyprzedzeniem. O sukcesie transakcji decydują nie tylko wyniki finansowe, lecz także porządek prawny, podatkowy i organizacyjny.
data.translatedTitle: How to effectively prepare for the sale of a business?
data.translatedDescription: Selling a company is a process that should be planned well in advance. The success of the transaction is determined not only by financial results, but also by the legal, tax and organizational order.

data.title: Uwaga na pułapki przy nabywaniu nieruchomości w Tajlandii
data.description: Zaostrzone kontrole w Tajlandii zwiększają ryzyko dla cudzoziemców kupujących grunty przez lokalne spółki. Do legalności nie wystarczy tajski wspólnik z większością udziałów.
data.translatedTitle: Beware of pitfalls when purchasing real estate in Thailand
data.translatedDescription: Tighter controls in Thailand increase the risk for foreigners buying land through local companies. For legality, a Thai partner with a majority of shares is not enough.

data.title: Gdzie łatwiej, a gdzie trudniej negocjować z deweloperami
data.description: Z nadpodażą oferty nowych mieszkań borykają się Łódź i Katowice, odwrotnie jest w Warszawie. Czy w jednych miastach klienci dyktują warunki, a w innych rządzą deweloperzy? Eksperci przestrzegają przed uproszczeniami, niemniej negocjować zawsze trzeba.
data.translatedTitle: Where is it easier and where is more difficult to negotiate with developers
data.translatedDescription: Łódź and Katowice are struggling with an oversupply of new apartments, while the opposite is true in Warsaw. Do customers dictate the terms in some cities and developers rule in others? Experts warn against simplifications, but negotiations are always necessary.

data.title: Większość pierwszych wdrożeń AI kończy się porażką. Biznes jest rozczarowany
data.description: Sztuczna inteligencja miała usprawniać działalność, ale wiele firm musiało najpierw zwolnić tempo. Winna nie jest technologia, lecz przedsiębiorstwa, które nie były gotowe na wdrożenie.
data.translatedTitle: Most initial AI implementations end in failure. Business is disappointed
data.translatedDescription: Artificial intelligence was supposed to streamline operations, but many companies had to slow down first. The fault is not the technology, but the companies that were not ready for implementation.

data.title: Działka, znajomi i długie śniadania. „Hobbitmaxxing” to sposób na wypalenie zawodowe
data.description: Wymęczeni pędem codziennego życia pracownicy korporacji wyłączają smartfona i wracają do prostoty. Na czym polega „Hobbitmaxxing”, który staje się coraz popularniejszy w sieciach społecznościowych?
data.translatedTitle: A plot of land, friends and long breakfasts. “Hobbitmaxxing” is a way to deal with burnout
data.translatedDescription: Corporate employees, tired from the rush of everyday life, turn off their smartphones and return to simplicity. What is “Hobbitmaxxing” that is becoming increasingly popular on social networks?

data.title: Rekordowe upały na Syberii. Termometry pokazały ponad 35 stopni
data.description: W lipcu w kilku regionach Syberii temperatura przekraczała 32 stopnie Celsjusza, a miejscami wzrosła powyżej 35 stopni. Znacznie powyżej średniej wypadły też wskazania termometrów w rosyjskiej części Arktyki.
data.translatedTitle: Record heat in Siberia. The thermometers showed over 35 degrees
data.translatedDescription: In July, in several regions of Siberia the temperature exceeded 32 degrees Celsius, and in some places it rose above 35 degrees. Thermometer readings in the Russian part of the Arctic were also significantly above average.

data.title: Estera Flieger: Dyplomacja po irlandzku
data.description: Patrick Haughey wraz z końcem sierpnia opuszcza placówkę w Warszawie. Ambasador Irlandii wykorzystywał portal X, by publikować zdjęcia z codziennej pracy oraz podróży po Polsce, dzieląc się pozytywnymi wrażeniami. W redakcji „Rzeczpospolitej” sprawiało nam szczególną radość, że dyplomata nauczył się języka polskiego, czytając naszą gazetę.
data.translatedTitle: Esther Flieger: Diplomacy in Irish
data.translatedDescription: Patrick Haughey leaves the facility in Warsaw at the end of August. The Irish ambassador used the X portal to publish photos from his daily work and travels around Poland, sharing positive impressions. At the "Rzeczpospolita" editorial office, we were especially happy that a diplomat learned Polish by reading our newspaper.

data.title: Najsłynniejsza restauracja świata wraca. Nowy szef kuchni i utrata gwiazdek Michelin
data.description: Słynna kopenhaska restauracja Noma ponownie się otworzyła, tym razem pod nowym kierownictwem. Założyciel lokalu, René Redzepi, jeden z najbardziej znanych szefów kuchni na świecie, zrezygnował ze stanowiska szefa kuchni po skandalu, który wybuchł kilka miesięcy temu. Nadal jednak pozostaje w firmie, ale w innej roli.
data.translatedTitle: The most famous restaurant in the world is back. A new chef and the loss of Michelin stars
data.translatedDescription: Copenhagen's famous Noma restaurant has reopened, this time under new management. The founder of the restaurant, René Redzepi, one of the most famous chefs in the world, resigned as head chef after the scandal that broke out a few months ago. However, he still remains in the company, but in a different role.

data.title: Reklama dopada Polaków już przy półce. Tysiące nowych ekranów w sklepach
data.description: Reklama coraz częściej czeka na klientów nie w telewizji czy internecie, ale bezpośrednio przy sklepowej półce. W Polsce działa już ponad 70 tys. cyfrowych ekranów reklamowych, a rynek retail media jest wart 1,7 mld zł.
data.translatedTitle: Advertising reaches Poles already at the shelf. Thousands of new screens in stores
data.translatedDescription: Advertising is increasingly waiting for customers not on TV or the Internet, but directly at the store shelf. There are already over 70,000 companies operating in Poland. digital advertising screens, and the retail media market is worth PLN 1.7 billion.

data.title: Kiedy uchwała nie narusza praw wspólnika mniejszościowego
data.description: Sprzedaż części majątku spółki w celu spłaty zadłużenia nie narusza dobrych obyczajów ani nie musi oznaczać pokrzywdzenia wspólnika mniejszościowego, jeśli służy ratowaniu przedsiębiorstwa.
data.translatedTitle: When the resolution does not violate the rights of a minority shareholder
data.translatedDescription: Selling part of the company's assets to repay debt does not violate good practices and does not necessarily mean harm to a minority shareholder if it serves to save the company.

data.title: Jak AI zmieni konkurencję w usługach księgowych
data.description: AI nie zabierze księgowym pracy, lecz klientów tym, którzy pozostaną przy tradycyjnym modelu usług. Przyszłość należy do biur rachunkowych wspierających klientów w podejmowaniu decyzji biznesowych.
data.translatedTitle: How AI will change competition in accounting services
data.translatedDescription: AI will not take away jobs from accountants, but will take away customers from those who remain with the traditional service model. The future belongs to accounting offices that support clients in making business decisions.

data.title: List żelazny dla Romanowskiego na łasce prokuratora? Niekoniecznie
data.description: Zmiany wprowadzone za czasów, kiedy ukrywający się dziś Marcin Romanowski był wiceministrem sprawiedliwości, uzależniają wydanie listu żelaznego od braku sprzeciwu prokuratora. Jednak część sądów uznaje, że decyzja prokuratora nie jest wiążąca.
data.translatedTitle: Letter of safe conduct for Romanowski at the mercy of the prosecutor? Not necessarily
data.translatedDescription: Changes introduced when Marcin Romanowski, who is currently in hiding, was deputy minister of justice, make the issuance of a safe conduct conditional on the prosecutor's lack of objection. However, some courts recognize that the prosecutor's decision is not binding.

data.title: Na jeden lístek. Doprava v metropoli a regionu bude jednodušší, ale i dražší
data.description: Cestování po metropoli a v jejím okolí má být propojenější a jednodušší, ale také dražší. „Praha a Středočeský kraj by měly uvažovat o přehlednějším společném tarifním systému,“ uvádí ve svém dopravním plánu pro následující roky Regionální organizátor pražské integrované dopravy (ROPID). Vzhledem k rostoucím nákladům organizace také navrhuje zvýšení cen jízdného.
data.translatedTitle: For one ticket. Transport in the metropolis and the region will be easier, but also more expensive
data.translatedDescription: Traveling in and around the metropolis should be more connected and easier, but also more expensive. "Prague and the Central Bohemian Region should consider a clearer common tariff system," states the Regional Organizer of Prague Integrated Transport (ROPID) in its transport plan for the following years. Due to rising costs, the organization is also proposing an increase in fares.

ner.entity: Regional Organizer of Prague Integrated Transport
ner.label: ORG

data.title: Farage porazil v doplňovacích volbách hraběte Koš a vrátí se do parlamentu
data.description: Lídr britské populistické strany Reform UK Nigel Farage vyhrál doplňovací volby v Clactonu, a vrátí se tak do parlamentu. Politik v červenci po skandálu s nepřiznanými dary v hodnotě milionů liber oznámil, že se vzdává svého poslaneckého mandátu a bude se o něj znovu ucházet. V doplňovacích volbách nyní získal více než 22 tisíc hlasů. Porazil tak soupeře pod jménem Count Binface neboli hrabě Koš.
data.translatedTitle: Farage defeated Count Koš in the by-election and will return to parliament
data.translatedDescription: The leader of Britain's populist Reform UK party, Nigel Farage, has won a by-election in Clacton and will return to parliament. The politician announced in July that he was giving up his seat as an MP and would run for it again after a scandal involving unclaimed donations worth millions of pounds. He has now received more than 22,000 votes in the by-elections. He thus defeated an opponent under the name of Count Binface, or Count Koš.

data.title: Z obchodu ve Francii ukradli Pokémon karty za téměř dva miliony korun
data.description: Lupiči v jihovýchodní Francii se v noci ze středy na čtvrtek vloupali do obchodu specializujícího se na sběratelské karty, zejména na Pokémony, a ukradli karty za téměř 80 tisíc eur (1,9 milionu Kč).
data.translatedTitle: Pokemon cards worth almost two million crowns were stolen from a store in France
data.translatedDescription: Robbers in southeastern France broke into a store specializing in collectible cards, especially Pokémon, on the night of Wednesday to Thursday and stole cards worth almost 80,000 euros (CZK 1.9 million).

data.title: Stíhačky NATO sestřelily nad Lotyšskem dron. Finsko kvůli hrozbě omezilo provoz
data.description: Lotyšská armáda v pátek ráno oznámila, že stíhačky NATO sestřelily dron ve vzdušném prostoru země. Finsko v podobnou dobu omezilo letecký a lodní provoz na východě Finského zálivu. Do vzdušného prostoru zemí sousedících s Ruskem či Ukrajinou letos opakovaně pronikly bezpilotní letouny zapojené do Ruskem vyvolané války na Ukrajině.
data.translatedTitle: NATO fighters shot down a drone over Latvia. Finland has restricted traffic due to the threat
data.translatedDescription: The Latvian military announced on Friday morning that NATO fighter jets shot down a drone in the country's airspace. At the same time, Finland restricted air and ship traffic in the eastern Gulf of Finland. Unmanned aircraft involved in the war in Ukraine provoked by Russia have repeatedly penetrated the airspace of countries neighboring Russia or Ukraine this year.

data.title: Klid nad Prahou. Provoz Letiště Václava Havla se vrací na hlavní ranvej
data.description: Letový provoz na pražském letišti se dnes odpoledne vrátí na hlavní dráhu. Kvůli modernizaci okolí hlavní ranveje byl na 4,5 měsíce převeden na vedlejší dráhu a letadla startovala i přistávala v dráze směřující nad centrum hlavního města.
data.translatedTitle: Calm over Prague. Václav Havel Airport operations return to the main runway
data.translatedDescription: Flight traffic at Prague Airport will return to the main runway this afternoon. Due to the modernization of the area around the main runway, it was transferred to a secondary runway for 4.5 months, and planes took off and landed on the runway heading over the center of the capital.

data.title: Večer jen Pražané. Lídr ANO Hušbauer chce revoluci parkovacích zón, zůstaly by dvě
data.description: Pražský lídr vládního hnutí ANO do komunálních voleb Jan Hušbauer plánuje revoluci parkování v hlavním městě. Stávající systém modrých zón, který si každá městská část řeší samostatně, by nahradily pouze dvě centrální. „Jedna by byla v historickém centru města a druhá by platila pro celý zbytek Prahy,“ říká v rozhovoru pro iDNES.cz Hušbauer.
data.translatedTitle: Only Praguers in the evening. ANO leader Hušbauer wants a revolution in parking zones, two would remain
data.translatedDescription: Jan Hušbauer, the Prague leader of the government movement YES to the municipal elections, is planning a parking revolution in the capital. The existing system of blue zones, which each city district deals with separately, would be replaced by only two central ones. "One would be in the historic center of the city and the other would apply to the entire rest of Prague," says Hušbauer in an interview for iDNES.cz.

data.title: Všichni proti AfD. Debata před německými volbami byla přehlídkou odsudků a osočování
data.description: Německo čeká za tři týdny hlasování, které je v mnoha ohledech přelomové. Ve spolkové zemi Sasko-Anhaltsko vévodí průzkumům tvrdě pravicová strana Alternativa pro Německo (AfD), která má s 42 procenty dokonce 20 bodů náskok před svými konkurenty, křesťanskými demokraty (CDU). Může se tak stát, že AfD bude poprvé vládnout některé ze 16 spolkových zemí.
data.translatedTitle: All against the AfD. The debate before the German election was a parade of condemnations and name-calling
data.translatedDescription: In three weeks, Germany faces a vote that is, in many ways, a turning point. In the federal state of Saxony-Anhalt, the polls are dominated by the hard-right Alternative for Germany (AfD), which, with 42 percent, is even 20 points ahead of its competitors, the Christian Democrats (CDU). It may thus happen that the AfD will govern one of the 16 federal states for the first time.

data.title: Srážka tří aut uzavřela na pět hodin D10. Jeden z vážně zraněných na místě zemřel
data.description: Dálnici D10 u Mladé Boleslavi ve směru na Prahu uzavřela ve čtvrtek odpoledne vážná nehoda tří aut. Jeden člověk po srážce zemřel, další lidé jsou zranění. Dálnice byla uzavřena více než pět hodin, provoz se obnovil až kolem 22:30.
data.translatedTitle: A three-car crash closed D10 for five hours. One of the seriously injured died on the spot
data.translatedDescription: A serious three-car accident closed the D10 motorway near Mladá Boleslav in the direction of Prague on Thursday afternoon. One person died after the collision, other people were injured. The highway was closed for more than five hours, and traffic did not resume until around 10:30 p.m.

data.title: Na Tchaj-wanu se výrazně zpomalil internet. Kvůli protičínskému cvičení
data.description: Na Tchaj-wanu se ve čtvrtek na několika místech na půl hodiny výrazně zpomalil internetové připojení jako součást poslední fáze každoročních vojenských cvičení, jejichž cílem je nacvičit reakci na možnou čínskou vojenskou invazi. Tchajwanský prezident Laj Čching-te požádal obyvatele o pochopení.
data.translatedTitle: The internet has slowed down significantly in Taiwan. Because of an anti-Chinese exercise
data.translatedDescription: In Taiwan, internet connections were severely slowed for half an hour in several places on Thursday as part of the final phase of annual military exercises aimed at rehearsing a response to a possible Chinese military invasion. Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te asked residents for understanding.

data.title: Německo přestává chránit Ukrajince v mobilizačním věku, hrozí jim i deportace
data.description: Ukrajinští muži, kteří jsou v mobilizačním věku, tedy od 23 do 60 let, a kteří prchají před hrozbou nasazené do bojů proti Rusku, už v Německu nezískají dočasnou ochranu. Dostat ji nově mohou jen pod několika podmínkami – například pokud jsou osvobozeni od vojenské služby. Těm, kteří se v zemi zdržují nelegálně, hrozí deportace.
data.translatedTitle: Germany stops protecting Ukrainians of mobilization age, they are also threatened with deportation
data.translatedDescription: Ukrainian men who are of mobilization age, i.e. from 23 to 60 years old, and who are fleeing the threat of being deployed to fight against Russia, will no longer receive temporary protection in Germany. Newly, they can only get it under several conditions – for example, if they are exempt from military service. Those who are in the country illegally face deportation.

data.title: VIDEO: Výboj z transformátoru zabil v Indii krávu. Místní napadli konstrukci holemi
data.description: V severní Indii transformátor zabil krávu. Rozzuření místní obyvatelé posvátné zvíře pomstili. Na transformátor se vrhli s dřevěnými holemi. Podobné incidenty se v Indii odehrávají často. Zvířata umírají po kontaktu s transformátory nebo se špatně zajištěnými elektrickými spoji.
data.translatedTitle: VIDEO: A discharge from a transformer killed a cow in India. Locals attacked the structure with sticks
data.translatedDescription: In northern India, a transformer killed a cow. The enraged locals took revenge on the sacred animal. They attacked the transformer with wooden sticks. Similar incidents happen frequently in India. Animals die after contact with transformers or poorly secured electrical connections.

data.title: Po Číně přinesla bouře záplavovou pohromu i Japonsku. Srážky jsou rekordní
data.description: Ve východní části Japonska napadlo rekordní množství srážek. Voda zaplavila silnice a domy a ochromila dopravu. Desítky tisíc domácností se v tokijské oblasti ocitly bez elektřiny. Podle hasičů následkem záplav zemřel jeden člověk ve městě Ičikawa. Japonští meteorologové vydali varování před silnými dešti ve 14 obcích prefektury Čiba.
data.translatedTitle: After China, the storm also brought a flood disaster to Japan. Rainfall is record high
data.translatedDescription: A record amount of rainfall fell in the eastern part of Japan. The water flooded roads and houses and paralyzed traffic. Tens of thousands of households were left without electricity in the Tokyo area. One person died in the city of Ichikawa due to flooding, according to firefighters. Japanese meteorologists have issued warnings of heavy rain in 14 municipalities in Chiba Prefecture.

data.title: V Jihlavě srazil vlak ženu, zraněním podlehla. Železnice stála tři hodiny
data.description: V Jihlavě ve čtvrtek vlak srazil ženu, vážným zraněním na místě podlehla. Okolnosti tragické události policie prověřuje.
data.translatedTitle: A woman was hit by a train in Jihlava, she succumbed to her injuries. The railway stopped for three hours
data.translatedDescription: A woman was hit by a train in Jihlava on Thursday, she died of serious injuries on the spot. The police are investigating the circumstances of the tragic event.

data.title: Vlak v brněnských Židenicích srazil a zabil člověka. Provoz hodinu stál
data.description: V brněnských Židenicích došlo ve čtvrtek kolem 16. hodiny k tragické události. Vlak tam srazil a zabil člověka. Incident popsala mluvčí jihomoravské policie Petra Hrůzová.
data.translatedTitle: A train hit and killed a person in Židenice, Brno. The traffic stopped for an hour
data.translatedDescription: A tragic event took place in Židenice in Brno on Thursday around 4 p.m. A train hit and killed a man there. Petra Hrůzová, spokeswoman for the South Moravian police, described the incident.

data.title: Silná exploze otřásla muniční továrnou u Říma. Úřady zatím nehlásí oběti
data.description: Silná exploze otřásla muniční továrnou u italského města Colleferro, pár desítek kilometrů od Říma. Úřady zjišťují, zda jsou nějaké oběti, a zatím žádné neoznámily. Exploze podle agentury ANSA nastala v oddělení lisování střelného prachu. Prokuratura incident vyšetřuje pro podezření ze žhářství
data.translatedTitle: A powerful explosion rocked a munitions factory near Rome. Authorities have yet to report any casualties
data.translatedDescription: A powerful explosion shook the ammunition factory near the Italian city of Colleferro, a few tens of kilometers from Rome. Authorities are investigating if there are any victims and have not yet reported any. According to the agency ANSA, the explosion occurred in the gunpowder pressing department. The prosecutor's office is investigating the incident for suspicion of arson

data.title: V severním Řecku zuří lesní požár. Turisté se evakuují po moři
data.description: Na severu Řecka, v přímořské oblasti Chalkidiki, ve čtvrtek odpoledne vypukl nový lesní požár. Úřady do akce povolaly několik letadel a vrtulníků a nechaly také evakuovat turisty. Požár vypukl v zalesněné oblasti asi 75 kilometrů jihovýchodně od druhého největšího řeckého města Soluně, kde rostou borovice, které v nynějších podmínkách snadno vzplanou.
data.translatedTitle: A forest fire is raging in northern Greece. Tourists are evacuating by sea
data.translatedDescription: In the north of Greece, in the seaside region of Halkidiki, a new forest fire broke out on Thursday afternoon. The authorities called several planes and helicopters into action and also had the tourists evacuated. The fire broke out in a wooded area about 75 kilometers southeast of Greece's second-largest city, Thessaloniki, where pine trees grow, which can catch fire easily in current conditions.

data.title: Finančák versus porno. Úřady jdou po byznysu na OnlyFans, chtějí vybrat miliony
data.description: Jde o jednu z nejstarších částí šedé ekonomiky. Český sexbyznys navzdory přesunu na internet nadále vydělává mimo dohled úřadů. A to platí i pro platformu OnlyFans. O změnu usiluje Finanční správa, která tvůrcům sexuálního obsahu doměřila miliony na dani z příjmu. Úředníci se chtějí zaměřit také na činnost samozvaných agentur, které podle tvůrců a policie využívají kuplířské praktiky.
data.translatedTitle: Financier versus porn. The authorities are after the business of OnlyFans, they want to collect millions
data.translatedDescription: It is one of the oldest parts of the gray economy. Despite the move to the Internet, the Czech sex business continues to make money outside the supervision of the authorities. And this also applies to the OnlyFans platform. The Financial Administration, which imposed millions in income tax on creators of sexual content, is striving for change. Officials also want to focus on the activities of self-proclaimed agencies that, according to the creators and the police, use pimping practices.

data.title: Tři vagóny převrácené na bok. V Anglii vykolejil vlak
data.description: Na jihovýchodě Anglie vykolejil ve čtvrtek odpoledne osobní vlak, tři vagóny jsou mimo koleje a převrácené. Prozatím nejsou hlášena vážná zranění. Na místě nehody zasahují záchranné týmy a v blízkosti přistály tři helikoptéry.
data.translatedTitle: Three wagons overturned on their side. A train derailed in England
data.translatedDescription: A passenger train derailed in southeast England on Thursday afternoon, with three carriages off the tracks and overturned. So far, no serious injuries have been reported. Rescue teams are at the scene of the accident and three helicopters have landed nearby.

data.title: OBRAZEM: Putin a vojenské námořnictvo. Vyzkoušel uniformy už všech druhů armád
data.description: Ruský prezident Vladimir Putin při cestě po Sibiři a Dálném východě navštívil také Kurilské ostrovy. Objevil se v uniformě vojenského námořnictva. Pod vojensku se ostatně obléká často, a to už přes 25 let. Podle analytiků se tak snaží působit jako válečný vůdce a spojovat se s úspěchy armády.
data.translatedTitle: PICTURED: Putin and the Navy. He has already tried on the uniforms of all kinds of armies
data.translatedDescription: Russian President Vladimir Putin also visited the Kuril Islands during his trip to Siberia and the Far East. He appeared in a military navy uniform. After all, he often dresses up under military uniforms, and has done so for over 25 years. According to analysts, he is thus trying to act as a war leader and associate himself with the achievements of the army.

data.title: Na útěku se cpal hranolky. Írán zesměšňuje Trumpův trik s letadlem
data.description: Tajná rošáda amerického prezidenta Donalda Trumpa při červencovém letu z Turecka do Velké Británie neunikla pozornosti íránských médií. Lídr USA tajně změnil letadlo poté, co zpravodajské služby zjistily hrozící nebezpečí ze strany Íránu. Trump stroj opustil v kontejneru na přepravu jídla. Íránci tak zveřejnili sérii montáží, ve kterých se Donald Trump na útěku uklidňuje pojídáním hranolků.
data.translatedTitle: He was chowing down on fries on the run. Iran mocks Trump's plane stunt
data.translatedDescription: The secret screening of US President Donald Trump during the flight from Turkey to Great Britain in July did not escape the attention of the Iranian media. The US leader secretly changed the plane after intelligence services identified an imminent threat from Iran. Trump left the machine in a food shipping container. The Iranians have published a series of montages in which Donald Trump calms down by eating French fries while on the run.

data.title: Třináct ukradených dodávek a sedm pokusů. Zloději brali výhradně jeden typ
data.description: Dva cizinci kradli na Trutnovsku, Královéhradecku, Liberecku a v Praze už od srpna 2015 dodávkové automobily. Vybírali si výhradně vozy Renault Master a celkem způsobili škodu téměř 13 milionů korun. Nyní už nenechavci čelí obvinění, jeden z dvojice je ve vazbě.
data.translatedTitle: Thirteen stolen deliveries and seven attempts. Thieves took only one type
data.translatedDescription: Two foreigners have been stealing vans in Trutnovsk, Hradec Králové, Liberec and Prague since August 2015. They exclusively chose Renault Master cars and caused a total of almost 13 million crowns in damage. Now the perpetrators are facing charges, one of the pair is in custody.

data.title: Jsme tví pěšáci, přísahá Kadyrov Putinovi. V realitě se do války zapojuje minimálně
data.description: Čečenský vládce Ramzan Kadyrov patří mezi nejhorlivější zastánce ruské války na Ukrajině a na papíře slibuje naprostou poslušnost vůči Kremlu. Ale, jak se říká, skutek utek. V realitě se v konfliktu diktátora Vladimira Putina snaží krvácet co nejméně. Jeho zájmy jsou úplně jinde, popisují zdroje z Kadyrovova okolí. A když musí, do bojů nažene obyčejné Čečence.
data.translatedTitle: We are your pawns, Kadyrov swears to Putin. In reality, he is minimally involved in the war
data.translatedDescription: Chechen ruler Ramzan Kadyrov is among the most ardent supporters of Russia's war in Ukraine, and on paper promises total obedience to the Kremlin. But, as they say, the deed escaped. In reality, dictator Vladimir Putin is trying to bleed as little as possible in the conflict. His interests are completely different, sources from Kadyrov's circle describe. And when he has to, he drives ordinary Chechens to fight.

data.title: Polsko zadrželo Rusa naverbovaného Moskvou. Plánoval vraždu, tvrdí Tusk
data.description: Polské bezpečnostní složky zadržely před několika dny Rusa naverbovaného ruskými zpravodajskými službami, který plánoval zabít ve Varšavě člověka s dvojím občanstvím – americkým a ukrajinským. Zamýšlená oběť byla podle polského premiéra Donalda Tuska nepohodlná z pohledu režimu ruského prezidenta Vladimira Putina. Moskva se zatím nevyjádřila.
data.translatedTitle: Poland detained a Russian recruited by Moscow. He planned the murder, claims Tusk
data.translatedDescription: A few days ago, the Polish security forces detained a Russian recruited by the Russian intelligence services, who planned to kill a person with dual citizenship - American and Ukrainian - in Warsaw. According to Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk, the intended victim was inconvenient from the point of view of Russian President Vladimir Putin's regime. Moscow has not yet commented.

data.title: Babiš obnoví národní koalici proti suchu. Voda se musí stát veřejným zájmem, řekl
data.description: Národní koalice pro boj se suchem vznikne v pondělí a hned začne fungovat. Na boj proti suchu včetně nových přehrad chce vláda čtyři miliardy korun, uvedl premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) po dnešní návštěvě vodní nádrže Slapy.
data.translatedTitle: Babiš will renew the national coalition against the drought. Water must become a public concern, he said
data.translatedDescription: The National Drought Coalition will be formed on Monday and will begin operating immediately. The government wants four billion crowns to fight the drought, including new dams, Prime Minister Andrej Babiš (ANO) said after today's visit to the Slapy water reservoir.

data.title: Plachta s Baťou skončila při bourání v hromadách suti, pokusí se ji vytáhnout
data.description: Rozměrná plachta s podobiznou zakladatele obuvnického impéria Tomáše Bati skončila při bourání vyhořelé výškové budovy ve Zlíně v hromadách sutin. Ve čtvrtek dopoledne ji s sebou strhla padající část objektu. Podle ředitelky Nadace Tomáše Bati Gabriely Končitíkové není Baťův odkaz ve věcech, ale v lidech.
data.translatedTitle: The sail with Baťa ended up in piles of rubble during demolition, he will try to pull it out
data.translatedDescription: A large tarpaulin with the likeness of the founder of the shoe empire Tomas Bata ended up in piles of rubble during the demolition of a burned-out high-rise building in Zlín. On Thursday morning, she was swept away by a falling part of the building. According to the director of the Tomáš Bata Foundation, Gabriela Končitíková, Bata's legacy is not in things, but in people.

data.title: Na Máchově jezeře začne festival elektronické hudby. Vystoupí přes 50 umělců
data.description: O víkendu startuje dvoudenní festival elektronické hudby u Máchova jezera v Doksech na Českolipsku. Podle organizátorů vystoupí na třech pódiích přes 50 umělců. Akce Mácháč každoročně v létě přiláká na pláž Klůček až 10 tisíc návštěvníků, akce se letos koná již po čtyřiadvacáté. Podle mluvčího festivalu Petra Tajčmana je letošní zásadní novinkou změna designu celého festivalu.
data.translatedTitle: An electronic music festival will start on Mách's lake. Over 50 artists will perform
data.translatedDescription: At the weekend, a two-day electronic music festival starts at Mách's lake in Doksy in Českolipsk. According to the organizers, over 50 artists will perform on three stages. The Mácháč event attracts up to 10,000 visitors to Klůček beach every year, this year the event is being held for the twenty-fourth time. According to festival spokesman Petr Tajčman, this year's major innovation is the change in the design of the entire festival.

data.title: Přijely z Prahy do Vídně, pak zmizely. Izraelskou matku s dcerou hledá i Mosad
data.description: Izrael a Rakousko pátrají po padesátileté Mali Yahalomiové a její třiadvacetileté dceři Liel, které zmizely během cesty po střední Evropě. Ženy odjely vlakem z Prahy do Vídně, kde se po nich v pátek slehla zem. V úterý večer nenastoupily na plánovaný zpáteční let zpět do Tel Avivu. Policie pracovala s podezřením na možnou zpronevěru, kvůli kterému uvalila na vyšetřování informační embargo.
data.translatedTitle: They came from Prague to Vienna, then disappeared. Mossad is also looking for an Israeli mother and daughter
data.translatedDescription: Israel and Austria are searching for 50-year-old Mali Yahalomi and her 23-year-old daughter Liel, who disappeared during a trip through Central Europe. The women took a train from Prague to Vienna, where the ground collapsed after them on Friday. They did not board the scheduled return flight back to Tel Aviv on Tuesday evening. The police were working on suspicion of possible embezzlement, for which they imposed an information embargo on the investigation.

data.title: Kde se v Praze dá stále koupat? Hygienici zakázali Šeberák, varují i před dalšími
data.description: Pražští hygienici zakázali koupání v rybníku Šeberák v Praze 4 Kunraticích, důvodem je masivní výskyt vodního květu sinic. Zároveň po měsíci zrušili zákaz koupání v nádrži Džbán v Praze 6, voda je tam však kvůli vysokému množství sinic stále nevhodná ke koupání. Stejný stav je na koupališti Motol v Praze 5. Informovala o tom mluvčí pražské hygienické stanice (HSHMP) Petra Batók.
data.translatedTitle: Where can you still swim in Prague? Hygienists have banned Šeberák, and warn against others
data.translatedDescription: Prague hygienists have banned swimming in the Šeberák pond in Prague 4 Kunratice, the reason being the massive occurrence of cyanobacterial bloom. At the same time, they lifted the ban on swimming in the Džbán reservoir in Prague 6 after a month, but the water there is still unsuitable for swimming due to the high amount of cyanobacteria. The same situation exists at the Motol swimming pool in Prague 5. This was reported by the spokesperson of the Prague Hygiene Station (HSHMP) Petra Batók.

data.title: Konec omezení. Na Kbelskou se po rekonstrukci vrátila auta, o dva dny dřív
data.description: Kbelská ulice na severovýchodě Prahy je po generální rekonstrukci. Plánovaných 45 dní oprav se podařilo o dva dny zkrátit, auta se do druhého opraveného pásu vrátila ve čtvrtek kolem půl páté odpoledne. Celá oprava přijde na zhruba 600 milionů korun.
data.translatedTitle: End of restrictions. The cars returned to Kbelská after the reconstruction, two days earlier
data.translatedDescription: Kbelská Street in the northeast of Prague is undergoing general reconstruction. The planned 45 days of repairs were shortened by two days, the cars returned to the second repaired strip on Thursday around half past five in the afternoon. The entire repair will cost approximately 600 million crowns.

data.title: Plameny z pole na Klatovsku zasáhly i blízký les, hašení komplikoval vítr
data.description: Desítky hasičů bojovaly s plameny na poli a v sousedním lese u Újezdce na Klatovsku. U požáru zasahovali s deseti cisternami a vyhlásili třetí ze čtyř stupňů požárního poplachu. Hašení jim komplikoval vítr.
data.translatedTitle: The flames from the field in Klatovska also reached the nearby forest, the wind complicated the extinguishing
data.translatedDescription: Dozens of firefighters fought the flames in the field and in the neighboring forest near Újezdek in Klatovsk. They responded to the fire with ten tankers and announced the third of four levels of fire alarm. The wind complicated their extinguishing.

data.title: Estados Unidos ameaçam Teerão com isolamento económico "sem precedentes"
data.description: O secretário do Tesouro dos Estados Unidos (EUA) ameaçou o Irão com isolamento económico "como o mundo nunca viu", apesar de Washington ter prometido, no início de agosto, um acordo para reabrir o estreito de Ormuz.
data.translatedTitle: US threatens Tehran with 'unprecedented' economic isolation
data.translatedDescription: The United States (US) Treasury Secretary threatened Iran with economic isolation "like the world has never seen", despite Washington promising, in early August, an agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

data.title: China doa mais 15 mil toneladas de arroz a Cuba
data.description: Cuba recebeu a terceira parcela de 15 mil toneladas de arroz do Governo da China, que enviou até agora 60 mil toneladas, como assistência alimentar de emergência perante a grave crise económica na ilha.
data.translatedTitle: China donates another 15 thousand tons of rice to Cuba
data.translatedDescription: Cuba received the third installment of 15 thousand tons of rice from the Government of China, which has so far sent 60 thousand tons, as emergency food assistance in the face of the serious economic crisis on the island.

data.title: Polícia brasileira recupera obras de Henri Matisse roubadas em dezembro
data.description: A Polícia Civil do estado de São Paulo, no sudeste do Brasil, anunciou a recuperação de obras do pintor francês Henri Matisse, roubadas em dezembro de uma biblioteca da cidade.
data.translatedTitle: Brazilian police recover works by Henri Matisse stolen in December
data.translatedDescription: The Civil Police of the state of São Paulo, in southeastern Brazil, announced the recovery of works by French painter Henri Matisse, stolen in December from a library in the city.

data.title: Lucros da operadora do jogo em Macau Melco aumentam 31,8% no segundo trimestre
data.description: A operadora de jogo em Macau Melco Resorts and Entertainment anunciou lucros líquidos de 22,7 milhões de dólares (20,7 milhões de euros) no segundo trimestre, um aumento de 31,8% em termos anuais.
data.translatedTitle: Macau gaming operator Melco profits rise 31.8% in second quarter
data.translatedDescription: Macau gaming operator Melco Resorts and Entertainment announced net profits of US$22.7 million (€20.7 million) in the second quarter, an increase of 31.8% year on year.

data.title: Bolívia lança plano de segurança para combater grupos criminosos brasileiros
data.description: A Bolívia lançou um plano de segurança na cidade fronteiriça de Guayaramerín, na fronteira com o Brasil, para combater a expansão no território boliviano de grupos criminosos estrangeiros, sobretudo brasileiros, ligados ao tráfico de droga.
data.translatedTitle: Bolivia launches security plan to combat Brazilian criminal groups
data.translatedDescription: Bolivia launched a security plan in the border city of Guayaramerín, on the border with Brazil, to combat the expansion into Bolivian territory of foreign criminal groups, especially Brazilian ones, linked to drug trafficking.

data.title: El Niño tem 69% de hipótese de ser o mais forte já registado
data.description: O fenómeno climático El Niño tem 69% de hipóteses de ser o mais forte de que há registo, alertou a Administração Nacional Oceânica e Atmosférica dos EUA (NOAA, na sigla em inglês).
data.translatedTitle: El Niño has a 69% chance of being the strongest ever recorded
data.translatedDescription: The El Niño climate phenomenon has a 69% chance of being the strongest ever recorded, warned the US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA).

data.title: Oposição promete pressionar Governo da Venezuela para libertar presos políticos
data.description: A oposição, em diálogo com o Governo da Venezuela, prometeu trabalhar pela libertação dos presos políticos, uma reivindicação antiga reiterada à margem da primeira ronda de negociações.
data.translatedTitle: Opposition promises to pressure Venezuelan government to release political prisoners
data.translatedDescription: The opposition, in dialogue with the Government of Venezuela, promised to work for the release of political prisoners, an old demand reiterated on the sidelines of the first round of negotiations.

data.title: Aviso amarelo devido ao calor hoje em vigor em quatro distritos
data.description: O aviso amarelo, devido ao calor, permanece hoje em vigor em quatro distritos de Portugal continental, informou o Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera (IPMA).
data.translatedTitle: Yellow warning due to heat in force today in four districts
data.translatedDescription: The yellow warning, due to the heat, remains in force today in four districts of mainland Portugal, informed the Portuguese Institute of the Sea and Atmosphere (IPMA).

data.title: Novo balanço aponta para 281 mortes e 379 desaparecidos após sismo na Colômbia
data.description: As autoridades da Colômbia elevaram para 281 o número de mortos em consequência do sismo de magnitude 7,4 de segunda-feira, acrescentando que 3.971 pessoas ficaram feridas e 379 continuam desaparecidas.
data.translatedTitle: New balance points to 281 deaths and 379 missing after earthquake in Colombia
data.translatedDescription: Colombian authorities raised the death toll from Monday's 7.4 magnitude earthquake to 281, adding that 3,971 people were injured and 379 were still missing.

data.title: Petrolíferas YPF, Eni e XGR anunciam investimento de 44.220 ME em gás argentino
data.description: A petrolífera argentina YPF, a italiana Eni e a dos Emirados Árabes Unidos XRG anunciaram na quinta-feira que irão investir 51.000 milhões de dólares (44.220 milhões de euros) num projeto para produzir gás natural liquefeito (GNL) na Argentina.
data.translatedTitle: Oil companies YPF, Eni and XGR announce investment of 44,220 ME in Argentine gas
data.translatedDescription: Argentine oil company YPF, Italy's Eni and United Arab Emirates' XRG announced on Thursday that they will invest 51,000 million dollars (44,220 million euros) in a project to produce liquefied natural gas (LNG) in Argentina.

data.title: EUA planeiam operações antidroga "em terra" na América Latina
data.description: Os Estados Unidos planeiam realizar operações antidroga "em terra" com os seus aliados na América Latina, além das já efetuadas em águas internacionais contra embarcações suspeitas de narcotráfico, revelou o secretário da Defesa, Pete Hegseth.
data.translatedTitle: US plans anti-drug operations "on land" in Latin America
data.translatedDescription: The United States plans to carry out anti-drug operations "on land" with its allies in Latin America, in addition to those already carried out in international waters against vessels suspected of drug trafficking, revealed Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

data.title: Trump anuncia taxas de 100% sobre importação de drones
data.description: O Presidente norte-americano, Donald Trump, assinou uma proclamação presidencial aplicando direitos aduaneiros, que podem chegar 100%, a importações de drones e componentes para estas aeronaves não-tripuladas, fabricadas sobretudo na China.
data.translatedTitle: Trump announces 100% tariffs on drone imports
data.translatedDescription: North American President Donald Trump signed a presidential proclamation applying customs duties, which could reach 100%, to imports of drones and components for these unmanned aircraft, manufactured mainly in China.

data.title: Porta-aviões ruma ao Médio Oriente após relatos de problemas no USS Lincoln
data.description: O porta-aviões norte-americano USS George Washington, a operar no Pacífico, zarpou hoje para o Médio Oriente, enquanto surgem relatos de problemas de saúde mental e de mantimentos a bordo do USS Abraham Lincoln, em missão há nove meses.
data.translatedTitle: Aircraft carrier heads to Middle East after reports of problems on USS Lincoln
data.translatedDescription: The North American aircraft carrier USS George Washington, operating in the Pacific, sailed for the Middle East today, as reports emerge of mental health problems and supplies on board the USS Abraham Lincoln, on mission for nine months.

data.title: Fisco francês alvo de ciberataque que permitiu extração de dados pessoais de contribuintes
data.description: O sistema de informação da administração fiscal francesa foi alvo, no final de junho, de um "acesso ilícito" que permitiu acesso e extração de dados de particulares e profissionais, revelou o Ministério da Economia.
data.translatedTitle: French revenue is the target of a cyber attack that allowed the extraction of taxpayers' personal data
data.translatedDescription: The French tax administration's information system was the target, at the end of June, of an "illicit access" that allowed access and extraction of data from individuals and professionals, revealed the Ministry of Economy.

data.title: Confrontos entre Huthis e exército do Iémen intensificam-se
data.description: Os confrontos entre os rebeldes Huthis, apoiados pelo Irão, e as forças governamentais no Iémen intensificaram-se desde a madrugada de quinta-feira, aumentando receios de que a guerra civil possa abrir uma nova frente no Médio Oriente.
data.translatedTitle: Clashes between Huthis and Yemeni army intensify
data.translatedDescription: Clashes between Iran-backed Huthi rebels and government forces in Yemen have intensified since the early hours of Thursday, raising fears that the civil war could open a new front in the Middle East.

data.title: Trump comemora decisão de tribunal sobre impostos em encomendas de baixo valor
data.description: O Presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, comemorou uma decisão judicial que mantém tarifas alfandegárias sobre as remessas de mercadorias de baixo valor (`de minimis`), impostas no âmbito da sua política comercial.
data.translatedTitle: Trump celebrates court ruling on taxes on low-value orders
data.translatedDescription: The President of the United States, Donald Trump, celebrated a court decision that maintains customs tariffs on shipments of low-value goods (`de minimis`), imposed as part of his trade policy.

data.title: Incêndio no norte da Grécia leva à retirada de centenas de turistas
data.description: Um novo incêndio florestal deflagrou na quinta-feira à tarde no norte da Grécia, na região turística de Halkidiki, levando à retirada de centenas de turistas e ao destacamento de meios aéreos que conseguiram controlar a situação ao anoitecer.
data.translatedTitle: Fire in northern Greece leads to the evacuation of hundreds of tourists
data.translatedDescription: A new forest fire broke out on Thursday afternoon in northern Greece, in the tourist region of Halkidiki, leading to the evacuation of hundreds of tourists and the deployment of aerial assets that managed to control the situation at dusk.

data.title: Plano de governo de Flávio Bolsonaro propõe limitar poderes do Supremo e retoma legado do pai
data.description: O candidato à Presidência do Brasil Flávio Bolsonaro (Partido Liberal) propõe limitar a atuação do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) e apresenta o Governo do pai, Jair Bolsonaro, como referência para as políticas que pretende adotar.
data.translatedTitle: Flávio Bolsonaro's government plan proposes limiting the powers of the Supreme Court and resumes his father's legacy
data.translatedDescription: Brazilian Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (Liberal Party) proposes limiting the role of the Federal Supreme Court (STF) and presents the government of his father, Jair Bolsonaro, as a reference for the policies he intends to adopt.

data.title: Flávio Bolsonaro recupera filiação partidária após fraude e pode registar candidatura
data.description: O Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) do Brasil restabeleceu hoje a filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro no Partido Liberal (PL), após uma fraude de filiação noutro grupo político ter impedido o registo da sua candidatura presidencial.
data.translatedTitle: Flávio Bolsonaro recovers party membership after fraud and can register candidacy
data.translatedDescription: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE) today reestablished Flávio Bolsonaro's membership in the Liberal Party (PL), after membership fraud in another political group prevented the registration of his presidential candidacy.

data.title: Peças soltas de motor partiram janela no voo da Ryanair em que passageiro foi sugado
data.description: A janela partida num voo da Ryanair em julho, que fez com que a cabeça de um passageiro fosse sugada para fora do avião, foi causada por peças partidas do motor do Boeing 737-800, segundo um relatório preliminar.
data.translatedTitle: Loose engine parts broke window on Ryanair flight where passenger was sucked out
data.translatedDescription: The broken window on a Ryanair flight in July, which caused a passenger's head to be sucked out of the plane, was caused by broken engine parts from the Boeing 737-800, according to a preliminary report.

data.title: Emirados Árabes Unidos denunciam ataque iraniano a dois navios em Ormuz
data.description: Os Emirados Árabes Unidos denunciaram e condenaram hoje um ataque do Irão contra dois navios pertencentes à empresa estatal ADNOC enquanto transitavam pelo estreito de Ormuz.
data.translatedTitle: UAE denounces Iranian attack on two ships in Hormuz
data.translatedDescription: The United Arab Emirates today denounced and condemned an attack by Iran against two ships belonging to the state company ADNOC while transiting the Strait of Hormuz.

data.title: IL quer criminalizar práticas de falso tráfico: "É uma questão de ordem pública"
data.description: O incidente na baixa de Lisboa na passada segunda-feira, em que uma turista foi atingida por uma bala perdida após um alegado desacato entre grupos que se dedicavam à venda de louro prensado, voltou a colocar o tema no centro do debate. A Iniciativa Liberal (IL) quer criminalizar o chamado falso tráfico de drogas e dar "um sinal de que há soluções que podem ser tomadas legislativamente" para responder a um 'vazio' legal.
data.translatedTitle: IL wants to criminalize false trafficking practices: "It's a matter of public order"
data.translatedDescription: The incident in downtown Lisbon last Monday, in which a tourist was hit by a stray bullet following an alleged clash between groups selling pressed bay leaves, once again placed the topic at the center of the debate. The Liberal Initiative (IL) wants to criminalize so-called false drug trafficking and give "a signal that there are solutions that can be taken legislatively" to respond to a legal 'void'.

data.title: Dois feridos graves em descarrilamento de comboio no sudeste de Inglaterra
data.description: Pelo menos 11 pessoas ficaram feridas, duas em estado grave, após um comboio com aproximadamente 150 passageiros ter descarrilado perto de uma cidade em East Sussex, no sudeste de Inglaterra.
data.translatedTitle: Two seriously injured in train derailment in southeast England
data.translatedDescription: At least 11 people were injured, two seriously, after a train with approximately 150 passengers derailed near a town in East Sussex, southeast England.

data.title: Assassínios de indígenas sobem 22% no Brasil e mortes infantis passam de 1.000
data.description: A violência contra os povos indígenas disparou no Brasil em 2025, com 258 assassínios, mais 22,3% do que no ano anterior, e 1.024 casos de mortalidade infantil, revelou hoje o Conselho Indigenista Missionário (Cimi).
data.translatedTitle: Murders of indigenous people rise by 22% in Brazil and child deaths exceed 1,000
data.translatedDescription: Violence against indigenous peoples skyrocketed in Brazil in 2025, with 258 murders, 22.3% more than in the previous year, and 1,024 cases of infant mortality, the Indigenous Missionary Council (Cimi) revealed today.

data.title: Cervejeira de Coimbra Praxis conquista título sundial no World Beer Awards 2026
data.description: A Praxis, cervejeira de Coimbra, conquistou um título mundial no World Beer Awards 2026, numa categoria que incorpora mosto ou uvas no processo cervejeiro, trazendo do Reino Unido um total de nove medalhas.
data.translatedTitle: Coimbra brewer Praxis wins sundial title at the World Beer Awards 2026
data.translatedDescription: Praxis, a brewery from Coimbra, won a world title at the World Beer Awards 2026, in a category that incorporates must or grapes in the brewing process, bringing a total of nine medals from the United Kingdom.

data.title: Aliados de Trump no Kennedy Center aprovam recolocação de nome do Presidente na fachada
data.description: A administração do Kennedy Center, controlado por aliados de Donald Trump, aprovou hoje a recolocação do nome do Presidente na fachada do centro de artes performativas de Washington, noticiaram vários media norte-americanos.
data.translatedTitle: Trump's allies at the Kennedy Center approve replacing the President's name on the facade
data.translatedDescription: The administration of the Kennedy Center, controlled by allies of Donald Trump, today approved the replacement of the president's name on the facade of the performing arts center in Washington, several American media reported.

data.title: Surfista portuguesa Yolanda Hopkins nas `meias` da etapa no Taiti
data.description: A surfista olímpica portuguesa Yolanda Hopkins apurou-se hoje para as meias-finais da sétima etapa da Liga Mundial de surf, no Taiti, ao vencer a norte-americana Caitlin Simmers, campeã do mundo em 2024.
data.translatedTitle: Portuguese surfer Yolanda Hopkins in the 'socks' of the stage in Tahiti
data.translatedDescription: Portuguese Olympic surfer Yolanda Hopkins qualified today for the semifinals of the seventh stage of the World Surfing League, in Tahiti, by beating North American Caitlin Simmers, world champion in 2024.

data.title: Filipe Coelho segue com Craiova para o play-off, Sá Pinto cai à Liga Conferência
data.description: O Universitatea Craiova, do treinador português Filipe Coelho, apurou-se hoje para o play-off da Liga Europa de futebol, enquanto o Pafos, de Ricardo Sá Pinto, foi eliminado e caiu para a Liga Conferência.
data.translatedTitle: Filipe Coelho continues with Craiova for play-offs, Sá Pinto falls to Conference League
data.translatedDescription: Universitatea Craiova, owned by Portuguese coach Filipe Coelho, qualified today for the play-offs of the Europa Football League, while Pafos, led by Ricardo Sá Pinto, was eliminated and fell to the Conference League.

data.title: Europeus de atletismo.  Delvis Santos ‘brilhou’ nos 200 metros após regressar da ‘baixa’
data.description: Dois dias depois de ter abdicado, por doença, das semifinais dos 100 metros, Delvis Santos foi o destaque de hoje da seleção portuguesa de atletismo nos Europeus Birmingham2026, ao chegar à final dos 200.
data.translatedTitle: European athletics.  Delvis Santos ‘shone’ in the 200 meters after returning from ‘downtown’
data.translatedDescription: Two days after giving up, due to illness, the semi-finals of the 100 meters, Delvis Santos was today's highlight for the Portuguese athletics team at the European Championships Birmingham2026, by reaching the final of the 200 meters.

data.title: Anderlecht, de Vítor Bruno, vence e segue para o play-off
data.description: O Anderlecht, que viu chegar esta época o treinador português Vítor Bruno (ex-FC Porto), apurou-se hoje para o play-off da Liga Europa de futebol, ao voltar a vencer os gregos do PAOK.
data.translatedTitle: Vítor Bruno's Anderlecht wins and advances to the play-offs
data.translatedDescription: Anderlecht, which saw Portuguese coach Vítor Bruno (ex-FC Porto) arrive this season, qualified today for the play-offs of the Europa Football League, after beating the Greeks from PAOK again.

data.title: Áustria Viena vence Beitar Jerusalém e marca duelo com Sporting de Braga
data.description: O Áustria Viena eliminou hoje o Beitar Jerusalém, nos penáltis (4-2), após o 2-1 favorável aos israelitas deixar a eliminatória empatada, e vai defrontar o Sporting de Braga na última 'barreira' para a fase de liga da Liga Conferência de futebol.
data.translatedTitle: Austria Vienna beats Beitar Jerusalem and sets up a duel with Sporting de Braga
data.translatedDescription: Austria Vienna today eliminated Beitar Jerusalem, on penalties (4-2), after the 2-1 in favor of the Israelis left the tie tied, and will face Sporting de Braga in the last 'barrier' for the league phase of the Football Conference League.

data.title: Creche da Amadora foi encerrada pela Segurança Social
data.description: A Segurança Social diz que a instituição estaria sobrelotada e que apresentava "risco iminente para a saúde, para a segurança e para o bem-estar dos menores". Sinalizada pela Polícia Municipal e alvo de uma inspeção, a creche foi encerrada de imediato.
data.translatedTitle: Amadora daycare was closed by Social Security
data.translatedDescription: Social Security says that the institution would be overcrowded and that it presented an "imminent risk to the health, safety and well-being of minors." Flagged by the Municipal Police and subject to inspection, the daycare was closed immediately.

data.title: Encontro de artes performativas 26 VOLTS regressa ao Porto de 08 a 11 setembro
data.description: O 26 VOLTS - Encontro Internacional de Artes Performativas está de regresso à antiga Central Termoelétrica do Freixo, no Porto, entre os dias 08 e 11 de setembro, acolhendo artistas de sete países, divulgou hoje a organização.
data.translatedTitle: 26 VOLTS performing arts meeting returns to Porto from September 8th to 11th
data.translatedDescription: The 26 VOLTS - International Meeting of Performing Arts is back at the old Freixo Thermoelectric Power Station, in Porto, between the 8th and 11th of September, welcoming artists from seven countries, the organization announced today.

data.title: Buscas por quarto português desaparecido na Croácia prosseguem esta sexta-feira
data.description: As buscas pelo quarto cidadão português desaparecido na Croácia, após um incidente num barco insuflável, prosseguem esta sexta-feira, anunciaram hoje as autoridades locais, no dia em que teve alta a portuguesa que estava hospitalizada.
data.translatedTitle: Search for fourth missing Portuguese in Croatia continues this Friday
data.translatedDescription: The search for the fourth Portuguese citizen missing in Croatia, after an incident on an inflatable boat, continues this Friday, local authorities announced today, on the day the Portuguese woman who was hospitalized was discharged.

data.title: Câmara da Lousã quer reforço de boas práticas e aposta na formação para restauração
data.description: A Câmara da Lousã anunciou hoje que a Autoridade de Segurança Alimentar e Económica (ASAE) vai promover ações de formação dirigidas a empresários e profissionais da restauração com o objetivo de apoiar a implementação e consolidação de boas práticas.

data.title: Bird flu kills 13,000 seal pups on remote Australian island
data.description:
SYDNEY: A pathogenic strain of bird flu killed more than 13,000 elephant seal pups after infecting a breeding colony on a sub-Antarctic volcanic island, Australian scientists said Thursday.
	Researchers found the remote Heard and McDonald Islands littered with seal carcasses when they arrived on a research expedition in October 2025.
	Genetic testing confirmed the contagious H5 bird flu strain had killed seals, penguins and birds living on the rocky outcrop — the first time it had been detected in one of Australia’s external territories.

data.title: Australia says net migration down as far-right popularity surges
data.description:
SYDNEY: Australia’s immigration levels fell last year, official data showed on Thursday, as its center-left government seeks to combat an ascendent far-right riding a wave of public discontent over soaring housing prices and cost of living.
	Net overseas migration added 301,000 people to Australia’s population of 28 million last year, Canberra’s Bureau of Statistics reported.
	Immigration minister Tony Burke said the figure was down nine percent from a year earlier and 45 percent lower than a post-Covid peak in 2023.

data.title: Oil falls to 3-1/2-month low after US, Iran sign ceasefire deal

	Brent crude futures were down $2.14, or 2.69 percent, at $77.41 a barrel as of 09:16 a.m. Saudi time, and US West Texas Intermediate fell $2.36, or 3.07 percent, to $74.43 a barrel.

data.title: Daily Telegraph columnist argues Saudi Arabia should join G7
data.description:
DUBAI: Saudi Arabia should be invited to join the Group of Seven nations as the organization adapts to a changing global order, according to a column published in the Daily Telegraph by former UK prime ministerial representative to Saudi Arabia Ken Costa.

	Costa argued that while the G7 was created in the aftermath of the 1970s oil crisis, the world has changed dramatically since then, with new economic and geopolitical powers emerging. Despite those shifts, he said the group remains largely unchanged and no longer reflects the realities of global influence.

data.title: Hôpital Central de Yaoundé : le « Bulletin Santé Messa » lance la feuille de route 2025-2027 pour un « Hôpital Vitrine »
data.description: © DR Mercredi 12 août 2026 à Yaoundé, l'Hôpital Central de Yaoundé a présenté la 2e édition de son magazine institutionnel Bulletin Santé Messa. Derrière cet outil de communication se cache une ambition politique forte : la mise en œuvre du Projet d'Établissement 2025-2027. Objectif affiché : transformer l'HCY en « Hôpital vitrine des soins hospitaliers de qualité accessibles » et renforcer la résilience du système de santé national. L’Hôpital Central de Yaoundé veut tourner une nouvelle page. Vieille de 95 ans, cette institution hospitalo-universitaire créée par l’arrêté n°2509 du 24 novembre 1931 s’est dotée d’une nouvelle feuille de route pour répondre aux défis de santé publique. C’est dans ce cadre qu’a eu lieu, le 12 août 2026, la conférence de presse de présentation du Bulletin Santé Messa, le magazine institutionnel de l’HCY. Loin d’être un simple support d’information, ce bulletin se veut le reflet d’une transformation profonde engagée par la direction. Un outil au service de la redevabilité À sa deuxième édition, Bulletin Santé Messa ambitionne de devenir « un outil de redevabilité, de pédagogie et de cohésion ». Il doit permettre à l’hôpital de rendre compte de ses chantiers, d’expliquer ses choix stratégiques et de valoriser les compétences de ses personnels. Mais surtout, d’ouvrir le débat sur les enjeux prioritaires de santé publique et de documenter les bonnes pratiques pour qu’elles soient répliquées dans d’autres formations sanitaires. Le cœur du dispositif : le Projet d’Établissement 2025-2027 Cette démarche de transparence accompagne directement la mise en œuvre du Projet d’Établissement 2025-2027. Élaboré de manière participative, adopté par le Comité de gestion et entériné par le Ministre de la Santé Publique, ce document constitue la véritable « feuille de route de la transformation de l’HCY ». L’ambition est clairement posée : faire de l’Hôpital Central de Yaoundé un « Hôpital vitrine des soins hospitaliers de qualité accessibles ». Concrètement, le projet s’articule autour de sept stratégies structurantes. Priorité est donnée à l’optimisation de la gouvernance, à la remobilisation des personnels et à la restauration de la confiance avec les usagers. Sur le plan technique, il prévoit la modernisation des infrastructures, des équipements et des pratiques, avec pour finalité une « prise en charge holistique et humanisée du patient ». Humanisation et Modernisation : le diptyque de la réforme L’HCY entend consolider son statut « d’institution hospitalo-universitaire d’excellence et d’humanité ». Cette transformation repose sur la devise de l’hôpital : Service – Qualité – Probité. Le Service met le patient au centre, la Qualité impose l’amélioration continue, et la Probité garantit l’éthique, la transparence et la responsabilité. Inscrite dans les orientations du Ministère de la Santé Publique, cette réforme vise aussi à contribuer à l’émergence du Cameroun à l’horizon 2035. « Fort de son histoire et de son statut d’institution de référence, l’Hôpital Central de Yaoundé entend jouer un rôle de leader de la transformation hospitalière », souligne la direction. En se voulant« institution apprenante », capable d’innover et d’évaluer ses interventions, l’HCY espère renforcer la résilience de l’ensemble du système hospitalier national et consolider durablement la confiance des populations. Avec le Bulletin Santé Messa et son Projet 2025-2027, l’Hôpital Central de Yaoundé pose les jalons d’un modèle hospitalier plus moderne, plus humain et plus accessible. Cet article Hôpital Central de Yaoundé : le « Bulletin Santé Messa » lance la feuille de route 2025-2027 pour un « Hôpital Vitrine » est apparu en premier sur Journalducameroun.com .
data.translatedTitle: Yaoundé Central Hospital: the “Messa Health Bulletin” launches the 2025-2027 roadmap for a “Showcase Hospital”
data.translatedDescription: © DR Wednesday August 12, 2026 in Yaoundé, the Yaoundé Central Hospital presented the 2nd edition of its institutional magazine Bulletin Santé Messa. Behind this communication tool lies a strong political ambition: the implementation of the 2025-2027 Establishment Project. Stated objective: transform the HCY into a “showcase hospital for accessible quality hospital care” and strengthen the resilience of the national health system. The Yaoundé Central Hospital wants to turn a new page. 95 years old, this university hospital institution created by decree no. 2509 of November 24, 1931 has adopted a new roadmap to respond to public health challenges. It is in this context that the press conference to present the Bulletin Santé Messa, the institutional magazine of the HCY, took place on August 12, 2026. Far from being a simple information medium, this bulletin is intended to reflect a profound transformation undertaken by management. A tool for accountability In its second edition, Bulletin Santé Messa aims to become “a tool for accountability, pedagogy and cohesion”. It must enable the hospital to report on its projects, explain its strategic choices and promote the skills of its staff. But above all, to open the debate on priority public health issues and to document good practices so that they can be replicated in other health facilities. The heart of the system: the 2025-2027 Establishment Project This transparency approach directly supports the implementation of the 2025-2027 Establishment Project. Developed in a participatory manner, adopted by the Management Committee and endorsed by the Minister of Public Health, this document constitutes the true “road map for the transformation of HCY”. The ambition is clearly stated: to make the Yaoundé Central Hospital a “showcase hospital for accessible quality hospital care”. Concretely, the project is structured around seven structuring strategies. Priority is given to optimizing governance, remobilizing staff and restoring trust with users. On a technical level, it provides for the modernization of infrastructure, equipment and practices, with the aim of “holistic and humanized patient care”. Humanization and Modernization: the diptych of reform The HCY intends to consolidate its status as “a university hospital institution of excellence and humanity”. This transformation is based on the hospital’s motto: Service – Quality – Probity. Service puts the patient at the center, Quality requires continuous improvement, and Probity guarantees ethics, transparency and responsibility. Included in the guidelines of the Ministry of Public Health, this reform also aims to contribute to the emergence of Cameroon by 2035. “With its history and its status as a reference institution, the Yaoundé Central Hospital intends to play a leading role in hospital transformation,” underlines the management. By aiming to be a “learning institution”, capable of innovating and evaluating its interventions, the HCY hopes to strengthen the resilience of the entire national hospital system and sustainably consolidate the trust of the population. With the Messa Health Bulletin and its 2025-2027 Project, the Yaoundé Central Hospital is laying the foundations for a more modern, more humane and more accessible hospital model.
